title: The shelf tab's snapshot
description: What `ingestion tui --view shelf --json` prints: each item on the shelf, as GET /api/v1/shelf answers it, in the order the tab draws them under its default grouping, and how the read stands. A change to its shape bumps schema_version.

taken_at.description: When the snapshot was taken, in UTC.

grouping.description: The tab's default grouping, which orders the items.
